

Minimum Prometheus-compatible metrics:

```text
jobs_total
jobs_active
jobs_failed_total

tasks_total{type,state}
task_duration_seconds{type}

provider_requests_total{provider,model,status}
provider_latency_seconds{provider,model}
provider_rate_limit_total
provider_schema_fail_total

ocr_pages_total
ocr_low_confidence_total

evidence_created_total{type}
claims_created_total{type}
claims_status_total{support_state}
verification_total{verdict,type}

disk_bytes{category}
queue_depth
worker_active
```

Avoid high-cardinality IDs in metric labels.

---
